I also appreciate that this CC cream is suitable for all skin types and comes in a range of shades to match a variety of skin tones. The medium deep shade is a perfect match for me and leaves my skin looking even and flawless.  Over

The CC cream is lightweight and long-lasting. I sweat a lot so I love that the CC cream is water proof and it doesn't come off unless you wash it off. If you have dark blemishes you should do several applications. If you love wearing make-up that doesn't cake up try this product. You will love it. I will definit

reviews.t: I've been looking for something like this product my whole life..!!
reviews.x: I like how easy it is to use... the effortlessness to apply! I used to put something on without having to much on my face!I love the ease of use and the mushroom head application puff is so soft and made with quality in mind!! I love that it comes in different shades...usually it's hard for me to find the right tone for my skin color!! I absolutely love the packaging how it comes with a cute little chiffon bag for the mushroom puff and the fingerprint on top of the lid of the container!!

I been looking for a product that would help with dark circles for a long time.To my surprise, I finally found it and I'm so happy.Not only  does it help with dark circles but it gives a full, light, flawless, coverage I been lookinging for.I really love it because it also moisturizes my skin.I have gotten many compliments.If you're looking for great coverage you need to get this cream foundation you won't regret it.

I have ordered all three shades of the primer. The 2 lighter shades are off the chain. Most days I am tempted (and I have) used it as my only foundation. But it is VERY light. The darkest color does not have the same characteristics. It is extremely sheer and not buildable at all. It doesn’t work well with other products. I would definitely recommend the two lighter colors and I wouldn’t waste my time on the darker.

I was excited about using this just to be disappointed. It is light on the face but covers nothing. Leaves my face with an oily feel. With this product I received a card with it stating if I leave a 5 star review I would receive a 50 dollar gift card. Well I am not going to lie about this product for $50. This stuff is a joke!!! I ordered the medium color and well it does nothing. Seriously do not waste your money.

This product is absolute GARBAGE! Little to NO coverage (even with multiple layers) and it’s way, WAY too light (color/tone)! I bought the darkest shade and it’s ghost white (I’m white .. but apparently not white enough). Unless you’re the color of Fresh Winter Snow … don’t bother! Very disappointed! Waste of time & my “golden gas” to go drop off this return. Pathetic!

This product provided the exact shading for my skin. It even covered a blemish on my chin that I've had for years. It is light, easy to apply using the sponge ball included, and most important it has never stained my clothing. Nor did it cake or crease on my face even in hot weather. I LOVE this product!

It is sheer but covers, and best of all I don't feel like I have anything on.  No it does not make me look like I am 22 again but I just feel like I look a little younger with it on.

I love the applicator. It makes it easy to blend. My skin is extremely dry during this time of year but when using this product my skin does not peel why wearing makeup.

Matches my skin tone.  Love the makeup sponge.  Moisturizes your face as well.  You only need a small amount for coverage.  After several uses it works perfect.

I loved how light weight and moisturizing this cc cream is as well matched my skin color perfectly. It corrected all my imperfections while still sheer.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the lightweight, easy application, often highlighting the included mushroom-shaped sponge/applicator.
Many reviewers describe the coverage as light and sheer, with some finding it moisturizing and skin-friendly.
Several reviewers report long-lasting, waterproof, or non-caking wear, including in hot weather.
A few negative reviewers say the product provides little to no coverage and leaves an oily feel.
Some reviewers complain about shade issues, saying the darkest shade is too light or ghost-white.
